notes:
A poetic compound of ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower) and {園|その} (garden), with rendaku voicing. Used both literally for a garden of flowers and figuratively for an idyllic or beautiful place. Also very common as a place name ({花園|はなぞの}) throughout Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花園|はなぞの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような: like a paradise
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花園|はなぞの}: dreamlike paradise
- {花園|はなぞの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to create a flower garden

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{花壇|かだん}→花壇：11075_kadan⟧: flower bed — more specific, refers to a raised bed for growing flowers
- ⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧: garden — formal garden, may include elements besides flowers
- {楽園|らくえん}: paradise — stronger term for an ideal, utopian place
